definition_zh: 在系统参数或激励具有随机性的条件下分析系统响应。
usage_note: random analysis 与 stochastic analysis 在所引文献中并用，不能将两词在全部数学语境中视为无条件同义。

complete_examples.text: Nevertheless, the integration of vehicle–track coupled dynamics with stochastic analysis may be a devel-oping tendency to obtain the dynamic behaviours and evolution patterns of vehicle–track systems in detail.

Until now, enormous achievements have been made at random fields of vehicle–track systems, but the vehicle–track temporal–spatial stochastic analysis considering the randomness of excitations and system parameters has not been completely established.

The stability and comfort of the vehicle will be significantly affected when the standard velocity of the crosswind reaches 15m/s, and the security of the vehicle will be damaged if the speed of the winds is over 25m/s.The model devel-oped in this paper can be applied to the stochastic analysis and reliability evaluation of vehicle-track systems.
依据车辆-轨道耦合动力学和随机分析理论,建立了用于横风、轨道随机不平顺联合分析的车辆-轨道系统随机分析模型。
在本文给出的计算条件下,当横风标准风速达到15m/s以上时,会逐步影响车辆的平稳舒适性,而当风速达到25m/s以上,行车安全受到严重威胁;此模型能够用于风环境下的车辆-轨道系统随机分析及可靠度计算。
